Package com.wualabs.qtsurfer.engine.indicators.statistics.pro

package com.wualabs.qtsurfer.engine.indicators.statistics.pro
Pro statistical indicators.

Advanced statistical computations: variance, standard deviation, z-score, correlation, covariance, beta, skewness, kurtosis, linear regression, autocorrelation, Hurst exponent, rolling percentile, and Value-at-Risk.
